source.test: 5d. PROSE: the strength and hypertrophy programs at intent zoom

ret: APRE 6RM on Barbell Bench Press: two ramp sets, a max-reps top set at your 6RM, then 2 sets of back-offs whose load is adjusted by how the top set went (steps 5 lb/10 lb), at 90% of it
Reads your estimated max (kept on file; ignored once older than 56 days).
Starts with 6RM = the load you could lift for 6 reps with 0 in reserve, given an estimated max of your estimated max for Barbell Bench Press; written by session, owner.

Plan: Barbell Bench Press: 1 set of warm-up 12 reps at 50% of your 6RM; 1 set of warm-up 6 reps at 75% of your 6RM; 1 set of as many reps as possible (at least 6 reps) at your 6RM; 2 sets of back-off 6 reps at 90% of (the load you actually did on “top” plus the APRE adjustment for the reps you actually did on “top” on the max set, in steps of 5 lb and 10 lb).

After each session: Set 6RM to whichever is known first: (1) the load you logged on “top” plus the APRE adjustment for the reps you logged on “top” on the max set, in steps of 5 lb and 10 lb; (2) your 6RM.

expected.ret: (by the top-set reps: up to 2 reps → minus 10 lb; up to 4 reps → minus 5 lb; up to 7 reps → 0 kg; up to 12 reps → 5 lb; more → 10 lb).
5 phases (Stabilization endurance, then Strength endurance, then Hypertrophy, then Maximal strength, then Power), starting Monday 2 November.

ret: Stabilization endurance (prog/opt-stabilization, 4–6 block weeks, advancing when the pushStab slot's rung is at least 2 and the squatStab slot's rung is at least 2; at 6 block weeks it asks you before moving on)
Strength endurance (prog/opt-strength-endurance, fixed); handoff: benchStart = nothing; rung = the pushStab slot's rung at the end of the previous phase
Hypertrophy (prog/opt-loaded, fixed); handoff: benchStart = the bench slot's working weight at the end of the previous phase
Maximal strength (prog/opt-loaded, fixed); handoff: benchStart = 115% of the bench slot's working weight at the end of the previous phase, rounded to the nearest 2.5 kg
Power (prog/opt-power, open); handoff: benchStart = the bench slot's working weight at the end of the previous phase
